content:
📅 Thursday, 26 January | ⏰2:30pm – 5:00pm | 📌 IMPIC Auditorium | Lisbon

BUILT CoLAB will publicly present the "Action Plan for Circularity in Construction" carried out under the Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry.

This event will also mark the end of the Protocol and is being organised together with APA and IMPIC. At the end of this session, BUILT CoLAB will also present the Sustainability in the Built Environment Award.

Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory 👉 here, with places limited to the capacity of the venue.

As a reminder, this Circular Agreement with the Construction Industry is the Collaboration Protocol driven by the Ministry of Environment and Climate Action, between BUILT CoLAB and the Fundo Ambiental, with the participation of partners APA – Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente, the Confederação Empresarial de Portugal (CIP), the Confederação Portuguesa da Construção e do Imobiliário (CPCI), the Associação dos Industriais da Construção Civil e Obras Públicas (AICCOPN), the Associação de Empresas de Construção e Obras Públicas e Serviços (AECOPS), the Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa de Construção (PTPC), and the Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção, I. P. (IMPIC).

Meet all the partners and find out more about the initiatives under this agreement at https://circularidade.builtcolab.pt/
